items.name: Authentic Jerk Chicken Plate
items.description: Marinated for 24+ hours in Chef Valma’s signature allspice, thyme, garlic, and Scotch bonnet marinade, then char-grilled to juicy perfection. Served with Island rice, grilled veg, and fried plantain.

items.name: Oxtail Plate
items.description: Slow-cooked until meltingly tender in rich, savory Caribbean brown sauce. Served with Island-style rice & peas, fresh grilled vegetables, and sweet fried plantain.

items.name: Caribbean Family Platter
items.description: The ultimate North Shore family feast! Includes 5 generous pieces of Jerk Chicken, tender savory Oxtail, a large tray of Island-style rice, fried sweet plantains, and grilled seasonal vegetables.

items.name: Jamaican Beef Patty Combo
items.description: Freshly baked, ultra-flaky Jamaican beef patty tucked inside warm, slightly sweet Coco Bread, paired with a chilled beverage of your choice.

items.name: Jamaican Patties (Dozen)
items.description: Stock your home freezer with Chef Valma’s handmade patties. Choose between Beef, Chicken, or Veggie. Perfect for quick lunches or after-school snacks ($7 each).

items.name: Coco Bread & Roti Shells
items.description: Authentic Caribbean breads baked with coconut sweetness. Stock up on tender, flaky breads ready for your curries, patties, and stews.
